name: 最终幻境
english_description: The Final Frontier (FF), a space-opera science-fiction MUD adapted from the 'Dongfang Gushi II' (Eastern Story II, ES2) codebase, founded by Spock — a rare sci-fi reskin within this collection's ES II/Eastern Story family, rather than the usual wuxia setting. New characters start in a newbie-academy hall and hand-allocate six attribute points (Strength/Agility/Intelligence/Perception/Constitution/Technique summing to 60) rather than rolling them; a transporter also reaches a 'Ceres' space station. Its own in-game banner announces that development has stopped: only 1 of 10 character classes/sects has a room placing it in the world at all, and even that one is currently inaccessible, leaving it a genuinely frozen, unfinished snapshot rather than a complete game.
